zones.title: Receive
zones.body: The gateway posts the SIP UUI once the INVITE is answered. Header auth. ParseStart splits the raw UUI; ResolveMarket: gateway value, phone prefix, language, PL. A missing correlationId or a UUI version other than 1 answers 400 and the call is released.

zones.title: Idempotency
zones.body: Prompts are loaded once. A re-delivered correlationId returns the existing session without speaking again.

zones.title: Identify and open the case
zones.body: Market row, CRM lookup by VIN, case. The model never sees the VIN or the number.

zones.title: Session
zones.body: Random session id, one row in ar_sessions per call, state starts at IDENTIFY. The greeting is the market's disclosure plus the ar_prompts greeting in the session language. Every start is logged to ar_events.

zones.title: Greet or hand over
zones.body: Backend down at start: the handover payload is built here and the greeting becomes the handover line.

panels.title: AR-01 Session start
panels.body: Gateway calls this once the INVITE is answered. Header auth. Re-delivery of a known correlationId returns the existing session without speaking again.
